description: Restore files to the active attempt's checkpoint (a git stash ref captured at attempt start). With no files arg, restores every file changed since the checkpoint. Returns restored/failed lists. Parity with the extension's restoreAttemptCheckpoint command.

feature.description: Feature slug; omit for the active feature.

files.description: Specific relative paths to restore. Omit to restore all files changed since the checkpoint.

ref.description: Override git ref to restore from (defaults to the stored attempt checkpoint).

name: cpfs_restore_attempt_checkpoint
